scoring_justification: The Debye temperature can be recomputed from the submitted mean sound velocity using the standard formula with hidden physical constants, and compared to the paper's elastic estimate of 714 K.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold Debye temperature target (714 K) and physical constants for recomputation
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported elastic Debye temperature for LiF (Huntingdon set) using Quimby-Sutton and Blackman method; physical constants from CODATA 2018.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Target value extracted from paper text: '...then both lead to an estimate of 714°K for Θ_D'. Physical constants are standard accepted values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Target is directly from the paper's reported numerical result; constants are authoritative and consistent with typical scientific usage.

outputs.description: Sound velocities (longitudinal, transverse, mean) and Debye temperature computed from elastic constants of LiF.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker recomputes Θ_D from the reported sound velocities using the standard Debye formula and compares to the paper's elastic estimate, while also checking internal consistency of v_m derived from v_l and v_t.
